data.description:
## Purpose
Implement the comment_response phase so RED tests pass.

## Scope
1. Add _phase_comment_response() to merge-to-main-pr.sh:
   - Capture fixed snapshot of current PR number at phase entry
   - Call: "$REPO_ROOT/.claude/scripts/dso" pr-comment-response --pr-number "$_PR_NUMBER" --output "$_snapshot_file"
   - Check if any accept handler pushed new commits (compare HEAD SHA before/after)
   - If new commits: re-run _phase_poll to re-verify CI against updated HEAD before merge proceeds
   - _state_write_phase "comment_response" and _state_mark_complete "comment_response" using existing helpers
   - On pr-comment-response exit non-zero: log warning and continue (non-blocking — do not fail merge)

2. Insert _phase_comment_response into PR mode top-level flow AFTER _phase_queue_auto_merge and BEFORE _phase_poll:
   Current:  ... -> _phase_queue_auto_merge -> _phase_poll -> ...
   New:      ... -> _phase_queue_auto_merge -> _phase_comment_response -> _phase_poll -> ...
   
   Rationale: auto-merge is already queued (won't trigger until CI passes); comment_response
   runs while CI is still pending; if accepts push new commits, _phase_poll will wait for
   CI on the updated SHA. This satisfies "after CI passes and before merge" because
   auto-merge only executes once _phase_poll detects all checks SUCCESS + MERGED state.

3. Add comment_response to _ALL_PHASES in merge-to-main-direct.sh:
   Current: _ALL_PHASES=(sync merge version_bump validate push archive ci_trigger)
   New:     _ALL_PHASES=(sync merge version_bump validate push archive ci_trigger comment_response)
   
   In direct mode, _phase_comment_response is a no-op (no PR URL). Add a stub:
   _phase_comment_response_direct() { _state_write_phase "comment_response"; _state_mark_complete "comment_response"; }
   Map it in the _ALL_PHASES resume loop for the direct strategy.
   
   For --resume: if state file lacks comment_response in completed_phases, resume loop
   correctly identifies it as the next incomplete phase and calls it. Works with both
   old state files (pre-addition: runs comment_response after ci_trigger) and new ones.

## Files to modify
- plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh (add _phase_comment_response function, insert into top-level flow)
- plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-direct.sh (add comment_response to _ALL_PHASES, add stub phase)

## Testing mode
GREEN — make RED tests pass
data.title: GREEN: Implement _phase_comment_response in merge-to-main-pr.sh and add to _ALL_PHASES
